notes.title: Sock Puzzle Skip Feature & New Achievement, etc.
notes.content:
1. We have recognized that the sock puzzle has been more challenging than originally intended for some players.
In particular, for certain players, this puzzle has become a source of frustration rather than an enjoyable challenge, 
sometimes even leading to them giving up on the game. This was not the intended experience.
To address this, we have added an option to skip the puzzle, allowing for a smoother gameplay experience. 
However, to ensure that players who complete the puzzle themselves still feel a sense of accomplishment, 
we have introduced a special achievement that can only be obtained by solving the puzzle without using the skip option.

2. The text displayed when clicking on the door after the lights go out has been changed.

If you have any further questions or suggestions regarding the game, 
please feel free to reach out via email or the Steam discussion board. 
We will do our best to respond as quickly as possible. Thank you.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: The issue where the name of the last item carried was displayed at the ending of the game has been fixed.
